clues: This city sits in a long valley on the slopes of a live volcano. That great peak stands in the high Andes range.
This city feels cool and fair all through the year. It has no big swing from hot months to cold months at all.
The Inca made this town the chief town of their north lands. Then Spain took it in 1534 and set it up anew.
This city is the world's chief town that sits closest to the equator. That famed line of Earth runs through its north part.
This land, Ecuador, is run from this city, its heart of rule. All its chief state offices and top teams are based here.
